files.changes: one action per frame on the approved element (BR-01 ref or exact role and name); the element must itself be the right control (Playwright's form calls otherwise follow a label to its control); fill never touches a field that looks secret (password type, secret autocomplete, secret-looking name or id); fill clears first; select chooses native <select> options by visible label only; zod schemas, the MCP response builder, code generation and multi-field forms are not ported

files.adapted: Orcel's SG-000077 actuation: Select and Check actions; FormInput with its approval state
files.changes: new code: the one-shot approval binds the exact value (fill), labels (select) or state (check)

files.adapted: form_binding and form_action on BrowserWorker; the form_action frame
files.changes: new code: verify and consume the approval, refuse every page-initiated document and popup during the action, keep the same document generation, refuse a URL change

authority_delta: New approval-gated browser actions (fill, select, check) on the committed document; each needs a one-shot approval bound to the node and the exact input. No secret field is filled; no document may open during the action.
residuals: press, hover, drag and bounded wait (the rest of BR-02) are not in this slice.
Non-native comboboxes (open, then choose by accessible name), multi-line textarea values and controls inside frames are refused.
orceld and the MCP tool contract do not expose these actions; changing the tool contract goes through governance.
A page may still navigate itself on its own origin after an action ends, as before (the existing page-initiated rule).
